jobs.prompt: Ultra-detailed architectural concept art painting of an ancient Chinese 平民独栋小屋，单进院子，三开间硬山顶民居，前有矮土墙，旁边一棵老槐树，鸡犬围栏，体量小（约同期普通农户家）， (Spring and Autumn period 770-476 BC atmosphere). STYLE: highly detailed architectural concept art painting, in the official art style of Ubisoft Anno 1800 / Anno 1404 / Manor Lords / Frostpunk / The Settlers, painted by Western concept artists Andre Kieschnik, Theo Engström, Andreas Rocha, Jaime Jones, Greg Rutkowski. TECHNIQUE: traditional Western digital oil painting / matte painting / impasto brushwork, thick painterly brush strokes layered on digital canvas, Flemish baroque oil painting tradition combined with modern game concept art, ArtStation trending architectural concept art quality, ultra-detailed 8k. STRICT NEGATIVES — DO NOT MAKE: 中国手游插画风 / 国漫 / 二次元 / anime / cartoon / chibi / stylized cute / 卡通 / 鲜艳饱和 / 圆润可爱 / 江南百景图风 / 率土之滨风 / 三国志手游风 / flat illustration / vector art / clean line art / 3D PBR render / CG render / polished game asset look / floating-in-void asset card. REALISM: photorealistic architectural proportions and structural authenticity, real building physics, real material weight and weathering, but rendered with visible painterly brush strokes (NOT a photo, NOT a 3D render). ARCHITECTURAL DETAIL DENSITY (critical): every individual roof tile painted distinctly, wood grain on every beam visible, mortar lines between stones, weathered patches, soot stains, water marks, peeling paint, rust on iron fittings, frayed cloth — the kind of dense architectural detail seen in Anno 1800 official concept paintings. MATERIALS: aged ceramic tile roof with realistic curvature and broken edge variation, weathered wooden columns with visible grain and chipped lacquer, stone foundation with mortar joints and erosion marks, packed-earth walls with cracks. COLOR PALETTE: heavily desaturated, naturalistic, aged, weathered, European old-master oil painting palette applied to Chinese architecture: muted teal-gray ceramic tiles (NOT bright green), oxblood/burgundy darkened columns (NOT bright vermilion), warm ivory weathered limestone, sun-bleached timber. Avoid any vivid saturated colors. ATMOSPHERE: cinematic afternoon golden-hour light, atmospheric perspective, soft warm sunlight casting realistic angled shadows on the building, subtle dust motes in air, slight depth haze. DECORATION (sparse and authentic, NOT decorative-overload): a few aged red lanterns, a hanging banner of plain cloth, a clay jar at the doorstep, woven baskets, an old gnarled tree with naturalistic foliage layers (NOT a blob shape), scattered hay or grain on stone — every prop painted with same painterly realism. VIEW: orthographic isometric 45-degree top-down architectural view (Anno 1800 game camera). BACKGROUND: pure black void background, building floats with dramatic painterly shadows. FORBIDDEN: text, watermarks, people, modern elements, signature, frame.
